## Security/privacy checklist

- [ ] No real secrets, tokens, private server details, production dumps, screenshots with personal data, or customer/user data were added.
- [ ] No private teacher materials or copyrighted files were added without permission.
- [ ] Admin/payment/file access boundaries are unchanged or explained.
- [ ] Docs updated if setup, env, API, or architecture changed.
- [ ] This does not add hosted-only behavior to OSS core.
- [ ] This does not add direct material checkout, seller payouts, or platform-managed deal handling to OSS v1.
